top_categories.workout_context: 10,499ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
125ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.

Road-specific control matters at Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 84 miles.
10,499ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 84, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 84 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Low-cadence force work supports 10,499ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

race_overlay.weather: June in Vaison-la-Romaine, Vaucluse, France (Mont Ventoux summit finish). Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux’s 84 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Colnago Gran Fondo Mont Ventoux rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Over Under to prepare you for 84 miles of mixed terrain in Vaison-la-Romaine, Vaucluse, France (Mont Ventoux summit finish).
